newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Daye Steel plans to issue 70 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: China's Daye Steel plans to issue 70 mln A shares.

text.p: One of China's top steel producers Daye Special Steel Co Ltd said on Monday it will launch an initial public offering of 70 million A shares in Shenzhen on March 14.
The offer, which will be completed by March 21, has been priced at 8.70 yuan per share, the company said in a prospectus in Monday's Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The company, which makes steel products for the automobile, machinery and petrochemical sectors, has appointed Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co as the lead underwriter, it said.

Daye said it aimed to raise 595.70 million yuan in net proceeds from the offer and use most of the money to buy a facility with an annual production capacity of 200,000 tonnes of steel automobile parts.
The facility will go into production by the end of 1997, Daye said, adding it will add 56.87 million yuan to its 1998 profit.
Daye, founded in 1993, said it forecast net profit of 143.05 million yuan for 1997, against 111.19 million yuan estimated for 1996 and 106.83 million yuan booked for 1995.
The company said it had after-tax profit of 103.57 million yuan in the first 11 months of 1996.
The company, based in Huangshi city in central China's Hubei province, is capable of making 700,000 tonnes of special steel and 550,000 tonnes of other steel products per year.
Daye, which sells the bulk of its products domestically, said it has averaged annual overseas sales of US$15 million in recent years.
Products are mainly exported to 27 countries and areas including the United States, Japan, South Korea and Germany, it said.
Daye has 209.228 million outstanding shares, comprising 171.228 million state shares, 15.20 million legal person shares and 22.80 million staff shares.
